celebi.pythonPath.description: Path to Python interpreter. If empty, auto-detects from virtualenv or uses 'python'

celebi.virtualenvPath.description: Path to Python virtualenv directory (e.g., /path/to/.venv). Auto-detected if empty

celebi.packagePath.description: Optional: Path to CelebiChrono package (if not in Python path)

celebi.servers.description: Named server profiles for quick switching between local and remote CelebiChrono instances.

host.description: SSH host (e.g., user@hostname). If set, commands run remotely.

pythonPath.description: Path to Python interpreter on this server.

virtualenvPath.description: Path to virtualenv on this server.

packagePath.description: Path to CelebiChrono package on this server.

celebi.activeServer.description: Name of the currently active server profile (from celebi.servers). Set by the Switch Server command.
